## Task / component

Choose docs/TASKS.md ID or describe a bounded new question and component.

## Target identity

Release and full binary SHA-256; relevant source/reference commit.

## Question and starting evidence

Addresses, source paths or existing packet. Seeds are not validated conclusions.

## Deliverable and acceptance

Evidence needed to answer the question. Identify required dependencies and any
execution approval; do not make a broad completion claim for a partial task.

## Ownership / files

Intended files and overlap with other work.
